summary: Corrected the batch-ordering knowledge entry so the pre-save readiness release cannot be read as an early completion. processReadyToRead passes its signals to pendingReadIndex.addReady and then applies LastApplied, and a batch completes only when the applied index reaches its ready index; the entry now states that condition, cites the existing process-ready excerpt alongside the batch-loop sources, and records the premise change with the vote-durability interpretation as its affected use. The vote-durability conclusion is unaffected because the early release carries no election state. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with a knowledge update and the derived investigation effect. No execution was run.
